newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Brent edges lower as NYMEX crude dips.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Brent edges lower as NYMEX crude dips.

text.p: Brent crude futures were quoted lower on Monday in Asia, weakened by a small drop in NYMEX crude prices trading on ACCESS.
January Brent futures were quoted on SIMEX at $22.90/$23.00 per barrel at 0415 GMT, down from the London settlement of $23.03.

Brokers said they expected the cold weather worries for the U.S. and Europe to keep the market supported, but noted that fears the Iraq/United Nations oil deal was close to being implemented was undermining the support.
In addition, the OPEC meeting this week in Vienna was likely to keep many players on hold, leaving Brent futures to range trade.
One broker said he expected a wide range for the January contract of $22.00 to $23.50.
Meanwhile, January NYMEX futures were last traded on ACCESS at $23.65, down 10 cents from the New York close of $23.75.
